title: 2018 Volkswagen Golf GTI Collision Repair
summary: Carcis Autobody Repair completed front-end collision repair on a 2018 Volkswagen Golf GTI damaged in a hit and run.
story: A 2018 Volkswagen Golf GTI arrived at Carcis Autobody Repair requiring front-end collision repair following a hit and run. Initial assessment showed impact damage to the front bumper cover, passenger-side headlight assembly, and front passenger fender, along with hood alignment issues.

Repairing front-end collision damage requires removing damaged body panels to inspect underlying impact structures and mounting brackets. Technicians repair or replace affected components, align panel gaps, and prepare surfaces for paint. The panels are then refinished and blended to seamlessly match the factory Metallic Dark Gray paint before final reassembly.
